header: Four people who tell us when we are wrong
lead: The board meets twice a year, in March and in October, and reads the same papers the partners do. None of them is paid by us and none of them holds a share in the office.
note: Board members declare any interest in a project before it is discussed, and step out of that item. The declarations are in the appendix of the annual report.
